+# 🔬 SPN-142 bounded capability admission — reviewer A
+
+Independent nonimplementing review. **Proceed with a narrowly scoped production candidate and its required semantic/negative controls.** The offline result justifies testing this implementation direction; it does not prove the original latency cause, production safety for every admitted input, current-head acceptance, or readiness to push. No browser/runtime workload was launched by this review and no source was edited.
+
+## 🔎 Evidence inspected
+
+Worktree base is 7679351822caaa9535d73d656191f2a6597a3380; only the SPN-142 decision checkpoint is dirty. Read the declared checkpoint, full probe.ts, both extracted experiment helpers, current patch generator/strict delete guard and relevant existing manager/semantic/work tests. Independently recomputed the retained capture, patch, installed ES/CJS and generated experiment hashes; all match results.json. Probe SHA-256 is 819f5ad0b0c89f387423463e518d2e1665ea9f5aab00d18cc1bf4bc3a1a45bda; results SHA-256 is 310f4dd235ea51dd923bdd08ac20a1937495c99c701cfe2ce030a5e15af9f5af.
+
+The result has exactly 320 unique format/case/scope/direction entries, all raw-equal. Input nonmutation is asserted after each control and candidate call. All redo primitive counts are unchanged; none of the recorded clone/iterator counters regress. The 32 Enter-position windows are overlapping transformations of retained synthetic captures, not 32 independent observations of the failed native interval. At position 5 the retained history Undo comparison decreases allocations 1240→352 and iterator calls 167→42. Workload source arithmetic maps states 385–416 to Enter at index 5 and an eligible inverse prefix of 26; there is no captured failed-interval cache proving that exact operation sequence occurred there.
+
+Probe-first.log and probe-watchdog.json record one successful execution, 1528 ms elapsed, sampled process-tree peak 431056 KiB, pressure 1. The probe operates on extracted helper functions using pinned Core and does not install a patch or execute a native manager/browser. Its instrumentation restoration is in finally. These primitive counts exclude guard scanning, descriptor checks, other JavaScript allocations, subscribers and runtime effects. They establish reduced measured composition work in the compared cases, not latency or GC reduction.
+
+## 🧩 Why the prefix boundary is coherent
+
+The proposed leading prefix independently satisfies the existing strict complete-group descending-delete rule: plain supported root-body actions, single-character deletes, guarded own fields/metadata and strictly descending adjacent offsets. For that qualified subset the already established native rule retains the lowest-offset action's body and combines delete length. Cloning that last prefix action before modifying its length avoids borrowing the input body for mutation.
+
+If that raw accumulator is exactly the original prefix fold, each subsequent JSONX.compose call receives the same accumulator and same next action in the same order. The proposal does not reassociate the structural tail, resume optimization after an unsupported action, change publication order or modify the insert branch. This is a limited extension of the existing rule rather than a new general composition algorithm. Keep the strict recursive plain-data/descriptor guard; do not admit getters, exotic prototypes, extra fields or arbitrary structural islands on the strength of these captures.
+
+## 🧪 Required controls before validation publication
+
+The following are admission obligations for the production candidate, not claims that the helper probe has already satisfied them:
+
+- Use the actual manager fixture in both ES/CJS builds. Compare complete raw history/collaboration publications against both native original and exact pre-SPN-142 patch, including own undefined fields, selections, mutation metadata and publication order. Apply resulting redo/undo operations to complete snapshots and compare with the independent sequential semantic oracle. Do not replace complete metadata equality with normalized text-only equality.
+- Exercise different history/collaboration cache lengths and eligible boundaries, forward and inverse direction, offsets including zero, odd lengths, full eligible groups, and prefix lengths 0, 1, 2 and immediately before/after the structural boundary. Include the retained mixed cache and all 32 paragraph positions. Ensure no optimization of later eligible islands after the first unsupported action.
+- Adapt the existing unsupported-delete controls to the new contract: every malformed/unsupported boundary still follows the original sequential tail, although an earlier valid prefix may now reduce work. Cover unknown/own-undefined fields, marker variants, range/paragraph/structural metadata, nonadjacent offsets, length/valueRangeId changes, accessors/non-enumerable fields, symbols and exotic prototypes. Keep full-fallback equivalence when the eligible prefix is shorter than two; use exact raw-output equivalence for longer safe prefixes, rather than deleting former negative coverage because its old whole-group work count changes.
+- Check ownership directly: composition and publication do not mutate retained input caches/actions/bodies; returned or published output must not alias mutable inputs in a way the old fold did not. The probe's immediate input-nonmutation assertion alone does not test post-return aliasing or manager cache/publication lifecycle.
+- Pin the exact current ES/CJS patch bytes as the pre-SPN-142 executable control. A meaningful work-reduction assertion must pass the new mixed-delete path and fail that prior implementation; preserve unchanged work/output for the insert path and already qualified complete-delete groups. Keep original/current/previous upgrade acceptance, partial/unknown-build refusal and fail-before-either-write installation controls. Reuse existing helper derivation rather than create divergent copies of qualification logic. Update the obsolete complete-group comment in the production version.
+
+These controls belong in the existing manager/patch suite and should be completed before any validation push. Numerical exact-commit reviews, feasible local checks and selected hosted acceptance still follow the standing process. Fresh unprofiled desktop/mobile workloads retain all original limits, grouping, history, input, drain, persistence and access criteria; a later pass cannot retrospectively identify the original 94.9-ms history interval's cause.
+
+## 🧭 Scope and personas
+
+XL remains appropriate for the full semantic qualification, integration and native acceptance, despite the small algorithm delta. Owner and Collaborator benefit only if exact edits/history/convergence are preserved while work is reduced. Link guest's permissions and revocation remain unchanged. Operator benefits from one finite, reproducible work-path hypothesis with no new scheduler, retry rule or runtime service. No complexity expansion is needed beyond a qualified prefix length, owned accumulator and unchanged sequential tail.
+
+No blocker to implementing this constrained candidate was found. Production correctness and latency acceptance remain pending; preserve unknown historical attribution and all first failures.

+# 🔬 SPN-142 offline capability and admission review B
+
+Independent nonimplementing review, 2026-11-04, against base `7679351822caaa9535d73d656191f2a6597a3380`. Inspected the dirty documentation checkpoint, temporary probe/experimental helper sources, retained results and watchdog, and existing patch/manager test infrastructure. No source edits or additional workload were performed.
+
+**Disposition: the evidence justifies implementing and testing this narrowly guarded leading-delete-prefix extension. It does not yet justify shipping the patch, claiming native latency acceptance, or attributing the failed 102.4 ms interval to this work.** No grade or validation-push approval is issued for an unimplemented candidate.
+
+## 📌 What the bounded probe establishes
+
+Independently verified the capture hash `714376723b3ef6a048796f7a1903a58181098960960cecb111e22e0594a2e7c8`, current patch-source hash and both experimental helper hashes against `results.json`. There are exactly 320 unique comparisons: eight retained caches plus 32 Enter-position windows, two cache scopes, two directions and ES/CJS helper forms. All 320 record raw deep equality, and the script asserts input nonmutation after both control and experiment. Allocation counts fall in 124 comparisons and increase in none; redo counts are unchanged throughout. Watchdog records command-passed at normal pressure, 1528 ms and sampled peak 431056 KiB. Instrumentation restoration is protected by `finally`.
+
+The position-5 history Undo case reduces counted allocations 1240 → 352 and iterator-next calls 167 → 42. Cases with only zero/one qualified inverse member retain original work. These counters measure calls/allocations through the existing native primitives, not heap bytes, GC pause duration or latency. The source arithmetic maps input states 385–416 to an Enter at offset 5 and a 26-delete inverse prefix. That mapping is not a capture of the failed interval and cannot establish its cause.
+
+The probe prepares the current patch in memory from hash-recognized installed OSS bytes, extracts helper text and evaluates it with the shared required Core runtime. ES and CJS helper generation are both covered; this is not full ES/CJS module installation, state-manager publication, native browser or independent dual-Core-runtime acceptance. The old historical cache capture remains distinct from current-source execution evidence.
+
+## 🧭 Why the narrow algorithm is defensible
+
+The experiment preserves the existing plain-data and exact native-shape guard, changing its result from whole-group Boolean to the length of the initial qualified descending single-character delete run. For a prefix of at least two, it deep-clones the lowest-offset member and changes only its delete length. That is the existing complete-group identity applied to a smaller prefix. It then folds every remaining action through the original JSONX.compose calls in order, never reorders a structural action or searches for later eligible islands. The insert path is unchanged.
+
+The intended proof boundary is therefore precise: the prefix result must equal the original sequential prefix accumulator in complete raw value/metadata shape; composing the identical tail in the same order must preserve the complete result. Deep-cloning the retained prefix action prevents newly mutating the source prefix. Tail ownership still relies on the original composition operation and must be checked in the integrated manager path; the probe's immediate input-nonmutation assertion alone does not prove there are no harmful result/input aliases after publication or later mutation.
+
+This reuses the existing SPN-135 delete identity and SPN-133 leading-prefix convention. It needs no new composition engine, cache policy, group size, timer, publication delay or dependency. The surrounding effort remains XL because proving the semantic boundary and actual integrated latency/access/history outcome is substantial even if the code edit is small.
+
+## 🧪 Required production proof before validation
+
+Use the existing real manager fixture and native semantic/work suites, retaining pristine sequential native and exact pre-SPN-142 patch controls. Do not replace the current algorithm with an implementation-mirroring test oracle.
+
+- Cover prefix lengths 0, 1, 2, odd/even and full group, empty/singleton states, zero/nonzero offsets, and independent history/collaboration caches with different valid prefix lengths and order. Verify complete publications, metadata and application/Undo/Redo snapshots, not only action output.
+- Put each unsupported member at the beginning, middle and end: nonadjacent/constant/ascending offsets, multi-character edits, insertion/mixed actions, Enter/C0/DEL, paragraph/section/custom metadata, unsupported markers, own undefined versus absent fields, styles/valueRangeId and unknown keys. Retain exotic-shape guard negatives (prototype/accessor/nonenumerable/symbol/depth). After the first rejection, the whole tail must remain the original sequential fold; later eligible islands must not be optimized.
+- Prove lowest-offset prefix body and metadata remain exact with deliberately different characters/styles/own fields, including when subsequent structural composition changes that accumulator. Require input nonmutation and appropriate ownership/isolation under later output mutation and shared input references.
+- Exercise actual full-manager publication order, cache draining and no-new-observer/timer behavior. Keep divergent cache and complete history/selection/segment/IME/access controls intact. Raw equality to the previously shipped patch and original native results must not normalize away meaningful metadata.
+- Preserve a meaningful work-reduction control that fails with the exact pre-SPN-142 patch. Unsupported-at-start and short-prefix cases should retain original work; eligible prefixes before unsupported tails may now legitimately reduce work. Existing whole-group fallback tests that demand unchanged counts for every unsupported position need a precise new boundary assertion, not wholesale weakening or deletion.
+- Preserve exact installer recognition/upgrades for pristine and every previously accepted patch, including the current full-group-delete patch; unknown/partial bytes must fail closed in both formats. Do not mutate installed packages during the admission probe.
+
+The 320 captured/window cases are useful regression inputs, not a substitute for these guards, manager semantics or fresh required native first attempts. Before those native runs, record the selected implementation contract and finite acceptance plan; keep diagnostic profiling separate from primary timing and preserve every new first failure.
+
+## 👥 Scope and remaining uncertainty
+
+Owner and Collaborator retain complete history, publication and persisted/peer edits; Link guest must retain identical native semantics and access fences; Operator gains a bounded primitive-work reduction without chance-based retries. Existing storage and Safari authority repairs remain separate.
+
+The retained peak contains a long history phase, but no captured failed cache or plain-sample profile identifies allocation/composition/GC/subscriber/scheduling cause. The proposed extension addresses demonstrable avoidable work on a relevant class of native inverse caches. Phrase that as an independently supported improvement and hypothesis to validate, not a proven repair of the historical spike. Keep the 100 ms maximum, all other limits and original 2086-input workload unchanged. Production admission remains conditional on complete implementation proof, both exact-source reviews and fresh selected acceptance.

-# ⏱️ SPN-142 Resolve the mobile native Doc capacity-flush budget failure
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Owner](../product/personas.md#owner), I want native Doc typing to stay within its registered responsiveness limits, so that saved collaborative editing remains responsive without losing history.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### A native capacity group meets its existing contract
-
-Given the retained first-attempt mobile capacity-flush failure,
-When its cause is investigated and a justified repair is integrated,
-Then the existing unprofiled desktop/mobile limits pass on fresh first attempts,
-And exact content, selection, actual-group history, saved/peer convergence and access boundaries remain intact.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve [the 102.4 ms failure, unknown inner cause, XL scope and prospective diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-142.md#registration-and-scope), agent judgment 2026-11-04 during the owner's continued SPN-120 merge work.
-- Retain 2086 native inputs, fourfold mobile throttle, 32-state grouping, 100-group history retention, 300 ms idle policy and all existing capacity/idle p95/max, input, long-task and drain limits. No forced GC, subtraction of unproved overhead, repeated assertion until green or profile substituted for acceptance.
-- Inspect retained phase/cache/source evidence first. Before further native execution, declare the discriminating hypothesis, exact source/instrumentation, finite count, stop condition and owned cleanup; reassess scope before a new algorithm or architecture.
-- SPN-141's storage repair, SPN-140's constructor repair and SPN-120's finite audit remain separate complete outcomes. Registration and diagnostic success do not satisfy their acceptance.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- Upstream stock-package retirement (SPN-122), native storage or Safari authority repairs, broader framework replacement, product UI redesign and relaxing acceptance.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Reuse current native history/composition semantic/work fixtures; establish a meaningful failing/negative control for the selected cause at the lowest useful layer before repair.
-- Keep isolated editors/peers, native drain witnesses, exact source/harness hashes, observed save/reload/access readiness and owned cleanup. Actual first-attempt desktop/mobile runs own latency; deterministic controls own semantics/work bounds.
-- Preserve scripts/dependencies, native history/sync/idle, evidence, responsiveness fixture/config and shared dependency routing. Keep diagnostics separate from primary samples and prove missing/failed selected evidence cannot pass.
-- Retain original/new failures, native phase/profile clock limits, complete content/history/access results, all required gates and two independent grades above 95 on each exact validation head. Integrate the accepted repair into each blocked PR and obtain fresh acceptance there.

-# ⏱️ SPN-142 Resolve the mobile native Doc capacity-flush budget failure
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Owner](../product/personas.md#owner), I want native Doc typing to stay within its registered responsiveness limits, so that saved collaborative editing remains responsive without losing history.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### A native capacity group meets its existing contract
-
-Given the retained first-attempt mobile capacity-flush failure,
-When its cause is investigated and a justified repair is integrated,
-Then the existing unprofiled desktop/mobile limits pass on fresh first attempts,
-And exact content, selection, actual-group history, saved/peer convergence and access boundaries remain intact.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve [the 102.4 ms failure, unknown inner cause, XL scope and prospective diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-142.md#registration-and-scope), agent judgment 2026-11-04 during the owner's continued SPN-120 merge work.
-- Retain 2086 native inputs, fourfold mobile throttle, 32-state grouping, 100-group history retention, 300 ms idle policy and all existing capacity/idle p95/max, input, long-task and drain limits. No forced GC, subtraction of unproved overhead, repeated assertion until green or profile substituted for acceptance.
-- Inspect retained phase/cache/source evidence first. Before further native execution, declare the discriminating hypothesis, exact source/instrumentation, finite count, stop condition and owned cleanup; reassess scope before a new algorithm or architecture.
-- SPN-141's storage repair, SPN-140's constructor repair and SPN-120's finite audit remain separate complete outcomes. Registration and diagnostic success do not satisfy their acceptance.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- Upstream stock-package retirement (SPN-122), native storage or Safari authority repairs, broader framework replacement, product UI redesign and relaxing acceptance.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Reuse current native history/composition semantic/work fixtures; establish a meaningful failing/negative control for the selected cause at the lowest useful layer before repair.
-- Keep isolated editors/peers, native drain witnesses, exact source/harness hashes, observed save/reload/access readiness and owned cleanup. Actual first-attempt desktop/mobile runs own latency; deterministic controls own semantics/work bounds.
-- Preserve scripts/dependencies, native history/sync/idle, evidence, responsiveness fixture/config and shared dependency routing. Keep diagnostics separate from primary samples and prove missing/failed selected evidence cannot pass.
-- Retain original/new failures, native phase/profile clock limits, complete content/history/access results, all required gates and two independent grades above 95 on each exact validation head. Integrate the accepted repair into each blocked PR and obtain fresh acceptance there.

+# 🔬 SPN-142 offline capability and admission review B
+
+Independent nonimplementing review, 2026-11-04, against base `7679351822caaa9535d73d656191f2a6597a3380`. Inspected the dirty documentation checkpoint, temporary probe/experimental helper sources, retained results and watchdog, and existing patch/manager test infrastructure. No source edits or additional workload were performed.
+
+**Disposition: the evidence justifies implementing and testing this narrowly guarded leading-delete-prefix extension. It does not yet justify shipping the patch, claiming native latency acceptance, or attributing the failed 102.4 ms interval to this work.** No grade or validation-push approval is issued for an unimplemented candidate.
+
+## 📌 What the bounded probe establishes
+
+Independently verified the capture hash `714376723b3ef6a048796f7a1903a58181098960960cecb111e22e0594a2e7c8`, current patch-source hash and both experimental helper hashes against `results.json`. There are exactly 320 unique comparisons: eight retained caches plus 32 Enter-position windows, two cache scopes, two directions and ES/CJS helper forms. All 320 record raw deep equality, and the script asserts input nonmutation after both control and experiment. Allocation counts fall in 124 comparisons and increase in none; redo counts are unchanged throughout. Watchdog records command-passed at normal pressure, 1528 ms and sampled peak 431056 KiB. Instrumentation restoration is protected by `finally`.
+
+The position-5 history Undo case reduces counted allocations 1240 → 352 and iterator-next calls 167 → 42. Cases with only zero/one qualified inverse member retain original work. These counters measure calls/allocations through the existing native primitives, not heap bytes, GC pause duration or latency. The source arithmetic maps input states 385–416 to an Enter at offset 5 and a 26-delete inverse prefix. That mapping is not a capture of the failed interval and cannot establish its cause.
+
+The probe prepares the current patch in memory from hash-recognized installed OSS bytes, extracts helper text and evaluates it with the shared required Core runtime. ES and CJS helper generation are both covered; this is not full ES/CJS module installation, state-manager publication, native browser or independent dual-Core-runtime acceptance. The old historical cache capture remains distinct from current-source execution evidence.
+
+## 🧭 Why the narrow algorithm is defensible
+
+The experiment preserves the existing plain-data and exact native-shape guard, changing its result from whole-group Boolean to the length of the initial qualified descending single-character delete run. For a prefix of at least two, it deep-clones the lowest-offset member and changes only its delete length. That is the existing complete-group identity applied to a smaller prefix. It then folds every remaining action through the original JSONX.compose calls in order, never reorders a structural action or searches for later eligible islands. The insert path is unchanged.
+
+The intended proof boundary is therefore precise: the prefix result must equal the original sequential prefix accumulator in complete raw value/metadata shape; composing the identical tail in the same order must preserve the complete result. Deep-cloning the retained prefix action prevents newly mutating the source prefix. Tail ownership still relies on the original composition operation and must be checked in the integrated manager path; the probe's immediate input-nonmutation assertion alone does not prove there are no harmful result/input aliases after publication or later mutation.
+
+This reuses the existing SPN-135 delete identity and SPN-133 leading-prefix convention. It needs no new composition engine, cache policy, group size, timer, publication delay or dependency. The surrounding effort remains XL because proving the semantic boundary and actual integrated latency/access/history outcome is substantial even if the code edit is small.
+
+## 🧪 Required production proof before validation
+
+Use the existing real manager fixture and native semantic/work suites, retaining pristine sequential native and exact pre-SPN-142 patch controls. Do not replace the current algorithm with an implementation-mirroring test oracle.
+
+- Cover prefix lengths 0, 1, 2, odd/even and full group, empty/singleton states, zero/nonzero offsets, and independent history/collaboration caches with different valid prefix lengths and order. Verify complete publications, metadata and application/Undo/Redo snapshots, not only action output.
+- Put each unsupported member at the beginning, middle and end: nonadjacent/constant/ascending offsets, multi-character edits, insertion/mixed actions, Enter/C0/DEL, paragraph/section/custom metadata, unsupported markers, own undefined versus absent fields, styles/valueRangeId and unknown keys. Retain exotic-shape guard negatives (prototype/accessor/nonenumerable/symbol/depth). After the first rejection, the whole tail must remain the original sequential fold; later eligible islands must not be optimized.
+- Prove lowest-offset prefix body and metadata remain exact with deliberately different characters/styles/own fields, including when subsequent structural composition changes that accumulator. Require input nonmutation and appropriate ownership/isolation under later output mutation and shared input references.
+- Exercise actual full-manager publication order, cache draining and no-new-observer/timer behavior. Keep divergent cache and complete history/selection/segment/IME/access controls intact. Raw equality to the previously shipped patch and original native results must not normalize away meaningful metadata.
+- Preserve a meaningful work-reduction control that fails with the exact pre-SPN-142 patch. Unsupported-at-start and short-prefix cases should retain original work; eligible prefixes before unsupported tails may now legitimately reduce work. Existing whole-group fallback tests that demand unchanged counts for every unsupported position need a precise new boundary assertion, not wholesale weakening or deletion.
+- Preserve exact installer recognition/upgrades for pristine and every previously accepted patch, including the current full-group-delete patch; unknown/partial bytes must fail closed in both formats. Do not mutate installed packages during the admission probe.
+
+The 320 captured/window cases are useful regression inputs, not a substitute for these guards, manager semantics or fresh required native first attempts. Before those native runs, record the selected implementation contract and finite acceptance plan; keep diagnostic profiling separate from primary timing and preserve every new first failure.
+
+## 👥 Scope and remaining uncertainty
+
+Owner and Collaborator retain complete history, publication and persisted/peer edits; Link guest must retain identical native semantics and access fences; Operator gains a bounded primitive-work reduction without chance-based retries. Existing storage and Safari authority repairs remain separate.
+
+The retained peak contains a long history phase, but no captured failed cache or plain-sample profile identifies allocation/composition/GC/subscriber/scheduling cause. The proposed extension addresses demonstrable avoidable work on a relevant class of native inverse caches. Phrase that as an independently supported improvement and hypothesis to validate, not a proven repair of the historical spike. Keep the 100 ms maximum, all other limits and original 2086-input workload unchanged. Production admission remains conditional on complete implementation proof, both exact-source reviews and fresh selected acceptance.

-# ⏱️ SPN-142 Resolve the mobile native Doc capacity-flush budget failure
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Owner](../product/personas.md#owner), I want native Doc typing to stay within its registered responsiveness limits, so that saved collaborative editing remains responsive without losing history.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### A native capacity group meets its existing contract
-
-Given the retained first-attempt mobile capacity-flush failure,
-When its cause is investigated and a justified repair is integrated,
-Then the existing unprofiled desktop/mobile limits pass on fresh first attempts,
-And exact content, selection, actual-group history, saved/peer convergence and access boundaries remain intact.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve [the 102.4 ms failure, unknown inner cause, XL scope and prospective diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-142.md#registration-and-scope), agent judgment 2026-11-04 during the owner's continued SPN-120 merge work.
-- Retain 2086 native inputs, fourfold mobile throttle, 32-state grouping, 100-group history retention, 300 ms idle policy and all existing capacity/idle p95/max, input, long-task and drain limits. No forced GC, subtraction of unproved overhead, repeated assertion until green or profile substituted for acceptance.
-- Inspect retained phase/cache/source evidence first. Before further native execution, declare the discriminating hypothesis, exact source/instrumentation, finite count, stop condition and owned cleanup; reassess scope before a new algorithm or architecture.
-- SPN-141's storage repair, SPN-140's constructor repair and SPN-120's finite audit remain separate complete outcomes. Registration and diagnostic success do not satisfy their acceptance.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- Upstream stock-package retirement (SPN-122), native storage or Safari authority repairs, broader framework replacement, product UI redesign and relaxing acceptance.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Reuse current native history/composition semantic/work fixtures; establish a meaningful failing/negative control for the selected cause at the lowest useful layer before repair.
-- Keep isolated editors/peers, native drain witnesses, exact source/harness hashes, observed save/reload/access readiness and owned cleanup. Actual first-attempt desktop/mobile runs own latency; deterministic controls own semantics/work bounds.
-- Preserve scripts/dependencies, native history/sync/idle, evidence, responsiveness fixture/config and shared dependency routing. Keep diagnostics separate from primary samples and prove missing/failed selected evidence cannot pass.
-- Retain original/new failures, native phase/profile clock limits, complete content/history/access results, all required gates and two independent grades above 95 on each exact validation head. Integrate the accepted repair into each blocked PR and obtain fresh acceptance there.

-# ⏱️ SPN-142 Resolve the mobile native Doc capacity-flush budget failure
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Owner](../product/personas.md#owner), I want native Doc typing to stay within its registered responsiveness limits, so that saved collaborative editing remains responsive without losing history.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### A native capacity group meets its existing contract
-
-Given the retained first-attempt mobile capacity-flush failure,
-When its cause is investigated and a justified repair is integrated,
-Then the existing unprofiled desktop/mobile limits pass on fresh first attempts,
-And exact content, selection, actual-group history, saved/peer convergence and access boundaries remain intact.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve [the 102.4 ms failure, unknown inner cause, XL scope and prospective diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-142.md#registration-and-scope), agent judgment 2026-11-04 during the owner's continued SPN-120 merge work.
-- Retain 2086 native inputs, fourfold mobile throttle, 32-state grouping, 100-group history retention, 300 ms idle policy and all existing capacity/idle p95/max, input, long-task and drain limits. No forced GC, subtraction of unproved overhead, repeated assertion until green or profile substituted for acceptance.
-- Inspect retained phase/cache/source evidence first. Before further native execution, declare the discriminating hypothesis, exact source/instrumentation, finite count, stop condition and owned cleanup; reassess scope before a new algorithm or architecture.
-- SPN-141's storage repair, SPN-140's constructor repair and SPN-120's finite audit remain separate complete outcomes. Registration and diagnostic success do not satisfy their acceptance.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- Upstream stock-package retirement (SPN-122), native storage or Safari authority repairs, broader framework replacement, product UI redesign and relaxing acceptance.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Reuse current native history/composition semantic/work fixtures; establish a meaningful failing/negative control for the selected cause at the lowest useful layer before repair.
-- Keep isolated editors/peers, native drain witnesses, exact source/harness hashes, observed save/reload/access readiness and owned cleanup. Actual first-attempt desktop/mobile runs own latency; deterministic controls own semantics/work bounds.
-- Preserve scripts/dependencies, native history/sync/idle, evidence, responsiveness fixture/config and shared dependency routing. Keep diagnostics separate from primary samples and prove missing/failed selected evidence cannot pass.
-- Retain original/new failures, native phase/profile clock limits, complete content/history/access results, all required gates and two independent grades above 95 on each exact validation head. Integrate the accepted repair into each blocked PR and obtain fresh acceptance there.

No browser/runtime workload was launched by this review and no source was edited.
+
+## 🔎 Evidence inspected
+
+Worktree base is 7679351822caaa9535d73d656191f2a6597a3380; only the SPN-142 decision checkpoint is dirty. Read the declared checkpoint, full probe.ts, both extracted experiment helpers, current patch generator/strict delete guard and relevant existing manager/semantic/work tests. +## 🧩 Why the prefix boundary is coherent
+
+The proposed leading prefix independently satisfies the existing strict complete-group descending-delete rule: plain supported root-body actions, single-character deletes, guarded own fields/metadata and strictly descending adjacent offsets. For that qualified subset the already established native rule retains the lowest-offset action's body and combines delete length. Cloning that last prefix action before modifying its length avoids borrowing the input body for mutation.
+
+If that raw accumulator is exactly the original prefix fold, each subsequent JSONX.compose call receives the same accumulator and same next action in the same order. The proposal does not reassociate the structural tail, resume optimization after an unsupported action, change publication order or modify the insert branch. This is a limited extension of the existing rule rather than a new general composition algorithm. Keep the strict recursive plain-data/descriptor guard; do not admit getters, exotic prototypes, extra fields or arbitrary structural islands on the strength of these captures.

+## 🧪 Required controls before validation publication
+
+The following are admission obligations for the production candidate, not claims that the helper probe has already satisfied them:

Include the retained mixed cache and all 32 paragraph positions. Ensure no optimization of later eligible islands after the first unsupported action.
+- Adapt the existing unsupported-delete controls to the new contract: every malformed/unsupported boundary still follows the original sequential tail, although an earlier valid prefix may now reduce work. Cover unknown/own-undefined fields, marker variants, range/paragraph/structural metadata, nonadjacent offsets, length/valueRangeId changes, accessors/non-enumerable fields, symbols and exotic prototypes. Keep full-fallback equivalence when the eligible prefix is shorter than two; use exact raw-output equivalence for longer safe prefixes, rather than deleting former negative coverage because its old whole-group work count changes.

The probe's immediate input-nonmutation assertion alone does not test post-return aliasing or manager cache/publication lifecycle.

A meaningful work-reduction assertion must pass the new mixed-delete path and fail that prior implementation; preserve unchanged work/output for the insert path and already qualified complete-delete groups. It does not yet justify shipping the patch, claiming native latency acceptance, or attributing the failed 102.4 ms interval to this work.** No grade or validation-push approval is issued for an unimplemented candidate.
+
+## 📌 What the bounded probe establishes
+
+Independently verified the capture hash `714376723b3ef6a048796f7a1903a58181098960960cecb111e22e0594a2e7c8`, current patch-source hash and both experimental helper hashes against `results.json`. All 320 record raw deep equality, and the script asserts input nonmutation after both control and experiment. Allocation counts fall in 124 comparisons and increase in none; redo counts are unchanged throughout. Watchdog records command-passed at normal pressure, 1528 ms and sampled peak 431056 KiB. Instrumentation restoration is protected by `finally`.
+
+The position-5 history Undo case reduces counted allocations 1240 → 352 and iterator-next calls 167 → 42. Cases with only zero/one qualified inverse member retain original work. These counters measure calls/allocations through the existing native primitives, not heap bytes, GC pause duration or latency. The source arithmetic maps input states 385–416 to an Enter at offset 5 and a 26-delete inverse prefix. That mapping is not a capture of the failed interval and cannot establish its cause.

ES and CJS helper generation are both covered; this is not full ES/CJS module installation, state-manager publication, native browser or independent dual-Core-runtime acceptance. The old historical cache capture remains distinct from current-source execution evidence.
+
+## 🧭 Why the narrow algorithm is defensible
+
+The experiment preserves the existing plain-data and exact native-shape guard, changing its result from whole-group Boolean to the length of the initial qualified descending single-character delete run. For a prefix of at least two, it deep-clones the lowest-offset member and changes only its delete length. That is the existing complete-group identity applied to a smaller prefix. It then folds every remaining action through the original JSONX.compose calls in order, never reorders a structural action or searches for later eligible islands. The insert path is unchanged.
+
+The intended proof boundary is therefore precise: the prefix result must equal the original sequential prefix accumulator in complete raw value/metadata shape; composing the identical tail in the same order must preserve the complete result. Deep-cloning the retained prefix action prevents newly mutating the source prefix. Tail ownership still relies on the original composition operation and must be checked in the integrated manager path; the probe's immediate input-nonmutation assertion alone does not prove there are no harmful result/input aliases after publication or later mutation.
+
+This reuses the existing SPN-135 delete identity and SPN-133 leading-prefix convention. It needs no new composition engine, cache policy, group size, timer, publication delay or dependency. The surrounding effort remains XL because proving the semantic boundary and actual integrated latency/access/history outcome is substantial even if the code edit is small.
+
+## 🧪 Required production proof before validation
+
+Use the existing real manager fixture and native semantic/work suites, retaining pristine sequential native and exact pre-SPN-142 patch controls. Do not replace the current algorithm with an implementation-mirroring test oracle.
+
+- Cover prefix lengths 0, 1, 2, odd/even and full group, empty/singleton states, zero/nonzero offsets, and independent history/collaboration caches with different valid prefix lengths and order. Verify complete publications, metadata and application/Undo/Redo snapshots, not only action output.
+- Put each unsupported member at the beginning, middle and end: nonadjacent/constant/ascending offsets, multi-character edits, insertion/mixed actions, Enter/C0/DEL, paragraph/section/custom metadata, unsupported markers, own undefined versus absent fields, styles/valueRangeId and unknown keys. Retain exotic-shape guard negatives (prototype/accessor/nonenumerable/symbol/depth). After the first rejection, the whole tail must remain the original sequential fold; later eligible islands must not be optimized.
+- Prove lowest-offset prefix body and metadata remain exact with deliberately different characters/styles/own fields, including when subsequent structural composition changes that accumulator. Require input nonmutation and appropriate ownership/isolation under later output mutation and shared input references.
+- Exercise actual full-manager publication order, cache draining and no-new-observer/timer behavior. Keep divergent cache and complete history/selection/segment/IME/access controls intact. Raw equality to the previously shipped patch and original native results must not normalize away meaningful metadata.
+- Preserve a meaningful work-reduction control that fails with the exact pre-SPN-142 patch. Unsupported-at-start and short-prefix cases should retain original work; eligible prefixes before unsupported tails may now legitimately reduce work. Existing whole-group fallback tests that demand unchanged counts for every unsupported position need a precise new boundary assertion, not wholesale weakening or deletion.
+- Preserve exact installer recognition/upgrades for pristine and every previously accepted patch, including the current full-group-delete patch; unknown/partial bytes must fail closed in both formats. Do not mutate installed packages during the admission probe.
+
+The 320 captured/window cases are useful regression inputs, not a substitute for these guards, manager semantics or fresh required native first attempts. Before those native runs, record the selected implementation contract and finite acceptance plan; keep diagnostic profiling separate from primary timing and preserve every new first failure.
+
+## 👥 Scope and remaining uncertainty
+
+Owner and Collaborator retain complete history, publication and persisted/peer edits; Link guest must retain identical native semantics and access fences; Operator gains a bounded primitive-work reduction without chance-based retries. Existing storage and Safari authority repairs remain separate.
+
+The retained peak contains a long history phase, but no captured failed cache or plain-sample profile identifies allocation/composition/GC/subscriber/scheduling cause. The proposed extension addresses demonstrable avoidable work on a relevant class of native inverse caches. Phrase that as an independently supported improvement and hypothesis to validate, not a proven repair of the historical spike. Keep the 100 ms maximum, all other limits and original 2086-input workload unchanged. Production admission remains conditional on complete implementation proof, both exact-source reviews and fresh selected acceptance.

-# ⏱️ SPN-142 Resolve the mobile native Doc capacity-flush budget failure
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Owner](../product/personas.md#owner), I want native Doc typing to stay within its registered responsiveness limits, so that saved collaborative editing remains responsive without losing history.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### A native capacity group meets its existing contract
-
-Given the retained first-attempt mobile capacity-flush failure,
-When its cause is investigated and a justified repair is integrated,
-Then the existing unprofiled desktop/mobile limits pass on fresh first attempts,
-And exact content, selection, actual-group history, saved/peer convergence and access boundaries remain intact.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve [the 102.4 ms failure, unknown inner cause, XL scope and prospective diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-142.md#registration-and-scope), agent judgment 2026-11-04 during the owner's continued SPN-120 merge work.
-- Retain 2086 native inputs, fourfold mobile throttle, 32-state grouping, 100-group history retention, 300 ms idle policy and all existing capacity/idle p95/max, input, long-task and drain limits. No forced GC, subtraction of unproved overhead, repeated assertion until green or profile substituted for acceptance.
-- Inspect retained phase/cache/source evidence first. Before further native execution, declare the discriminating hypothesis, exact source/instrumentation, finite count, stop condition and owned cleanup; reassess scope before a new algorithm or architecture.
-- SPN-141's storage repair, SPN-140's constructor repair and SPN-120's finite audit remain separate complete outcomes. Registration and diagnostic success do not satisfy their acceptance.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- Upstream stock-package retirement (SPN-122), native storage or Safari authority repairs, broader framework replacement, product UI redesign and relaxing acceptance.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Reuse current native history/composition semantic/work fixtures; establish a meaningful failing/negative control for the selected cause at the lowest useful layer before repair.
-- Keep isolated editors/peers, native drain witnesses, exact source/harness hashes, observed save/reload/access readiness and owned cleanup. Actual first-attempt desktop/mobile runs own latency; deterministic controls own semantics/work bounds.
-- Preserve scripts/dependencies, native history/sync/idle, evidence, responsiveness fixture/config and shared dependency routing. Keep diagnostics separate from primary samples and prove missing/failed selected evidence cannot pass.
-- Retain original/new failures, native phase/profile clock limits, complete content/history/access results, all required gates and two independent grades above 95 on each exact validation head. Integrate the accepted repair into each blocked PR and obtain fresh acceptance there.

The source arithmetic maps input states 385–416 to an Enter at offset 5 and a 26-delete inverse prefix. That mapping is not a capture of the failed interval and cannot establish its cause.
+
+The probe prepares the current patch in memory from hash-recognized installed OSS bytes, extracts helper text and evaluates it with the shared required Core runtime. ES and CJS helper generation are both covered; this is not full ES/CJS module installation, state-manager publication, native browser or independent dual-Core-runtime acceptance. The old historical cache capture remains distinct from current-source execution evidence.
+
+## 🧭 Why the narrow algorithm is defensible
+
+The experiment preserves the existing plain-data and exact native-shape guard, changing its result from whole-group Boolean to the length of the initial qualified descending single-character delete run. For a prefix of at least two, it deep-clones the lowest-offset member and changes only its delete length. That is the existing complete-group identity applied to a smaller prefix. It then folds every remaining action through the original JSONX.compose calls in order, never reorders a structural action or searches for later eligible islands. The insert path is unchanged.
+
+The intended proof boundary is therefore precise: the prefix result must equal the original sequential prefix accumulator in complete raw value/metadata shape; composing the identical tail in the same order must preserve the complete result. Deep-cloning the retained prefix action prevents newly mutating the source prefix. Tail ownership still relies on the original composition operation and must be checked in the integrated manager path; the probe's immediate input-nonmutation assertion alone does not prove there are no harmful result/input aliases after publication or later mutation.
+
+This reuses the existing SPN-135 delete identity and SPN-133 leading-prefix convention. It needs no new composition engine, cache policy, group size, timer, publication delay or dependency. The surrounding effort remains XL because proving the semantic boundary and actual integrated latency/access/history outcome is substantial even if the code edit is small.
+
+## 🧪 Required production proof before validation
+
+Use the existing real manager fixture and native semantic/work suites, retaining pristine sequential native and exact pre-SPN-142 patch controls. Do not replace the current algorithm with an implementation-mirroring test oracle.
+
+- Cover prefix lengths 0, 1, 2, odd/even and full group, empty/singleton states, zero/nonzero offsets, and independent history/collaboration caches with different valid prefix lengths and order. Verify complete publications, metadata and application/Undo/Redo snapshots, not only action output.
+- Put each unsupported member at the beginning, middle and end: nonadjacent/constant/ascending offsets, multi-character edits, insertion/mixed actions, Enter/C0/DEL, paragraph/section/custom metadata, unsupported markers, own undefined versus absent fields, styles/valueRangeId and unknown keys. Retain exotic-shape guard negatives (prototype/accessor/nonenumerable/symbol/depth). After the first rejection, the whole tail must remain the original sequential fold; later eligible islands must not be optimized.
+- Prove lowest-offset prefix body and metadata remain exact with deliberately different characters/styles/own fields, including when subsequent structural composition changes that accumulator. Require input nonmutation and appropriate ownership/isolation under later output mutation and shared input references.
+- Exercise actual full-manager publication order, cache draining and no-new-observer/timer behavior. Keep divergent cache and complete history/selection/segment/IME/access controls intact. Raw equality to the previously shipped patch and original native results must not normalize away meaningful metadata.
+- Preserve a meaningful work-reduction control that fails with the exact pre-SPN-142 patch. Unsupported-at-start and short-prefix cases should retain original work; eligible prefixes before unsupported tails may now legitimately reduce work. Existing whole-group fallback tests that demand unchanged counts for every unsupported position need a precise new boundary assertion, not wholesale weakening or deletion.
+- Preserve exact installer recognition/upgrades for pristine and every previously accepted patch, including the current full-group-delete patch; unknown/partial bytes must fail closed in both formats. Do not mutate installed packages during the admission probe.
+
+The 320 captured/window cases are useful regression inputs, not a substitute for these guards, manager semantics or fresh required native first attempts. Before those native runs, record the selected implementation contract and finite acceptance plan; keep diagnostic profiling separate from primary timing and preserve every new first failure.
+
+## 👥 Scope and remaining uncertainty
+
+Owner and Collaborator retain complete history, publication and persisted/peer edits; Link guest must retain identical native semantics and access fences; Operator gains a bounded primitive-work reduction without chance-based retries. Existing storage and Safari authority repairs remain separate.
+
+The retained peak contains a long history phase, but no captured failed cache or plain-sample profile identifies allocation/composition/GC/subscriber/scheduling cause. The proposed extension addresses demonstrable avoidable work on a relevant class of native inverse caches. Phrase that as an independently supported improvement and hypothesis to validate, not a proven repair of the historical spike. Keep the 100 ms maximum, all other limits and original 2086-input workload unchanged. Production admission remains conditional on complete implementation proof, both exact-source reviews and fresh selected acceptance.

-# ⏱️ SPN-142 Resolve the mobile native Doc capacity-flush budget failure
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Owner](../product/personas.md#owner), I want native Doc typing to stay within its registered responsiveness limits, so that saved collaborative editing remains responsive without losing history.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### A native capacity group meets its existing contract
-
-Given the retained first-attempt mobile capacity-flush failure,
-When its cause is investigated and a justified repair is integrated,
-Then the existing unprofiled desktop/mobile limits pass on fresh first attempts,
-And exact content, selection, actual-group history, saved/peer convergence and access boundaries remain intact.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve [the 102.4 ms failure, unknown inner cause, XL scope and prospective diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-142.md#registration-and-scope), agent judgment 2026-11-04 during the owner's continued SPN-120 merge work.
-- Retain 2086 native inputs, fourfold mobile throttle, 32-state grouping, 100-group history retention, 300 ms idle policy and all existing capacity/idle p95/max, input, long-task and drain limits. No forced GC, subtraction of unproved overhead, repeated assertion until green or profile substituted for acceptance.
-- Inspect retained phase/cache/source evidence first. Before further native execution, declare the discriminating hypothesis, exact source/instrumentation, finite count, stop condition and owned cleanup; reassess scope before a new algorithm or architecture.
-- SPN-141's storage repair, SPN-140's constructor repair and SPN-120's finite audit remain separate complete outcomes. Registration and diagnostic success do not satisfy their acceptance.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- Upstream stock-package retirement (SPN-122), native storage or Safari authority repairs, broader framework replacement, product UI redesign and relaxing acceptance.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Reuse current native history/composition semantic/work fixtures; establish a meaningful failing/negative control for the selected cause at the lowest useful layer before repair.
-- Keep isolated editors/peers, native drain witnesses, exact source/harness hashes, observed save/reload/access readiness and owned cleanup. Actual first-attempt desktop/mobile runs own latency; deterministic controls own semantics/work bounds.
-- Preserve scripts/dependencies, native history/sync/idle, evidence, responsiveness fixture/config and shared dependency routing. Keep diagnostics separate from primary samples and prove missing/failed selected evidence cannot pass.
-- Retain original/new failures, native phase/profile clock limits, complete content/history/access results, all required gates and two independent grades above 95 on each exact validation head. Integrate the accepted repair into each blocked PR and obtain fresh acceptance there.

-# ⏱️ SPN-142 Resolve the mobile native Doc capacity-flush budget failure
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Owner](../product/personas.md#owner), I want native Doc typing to stay within its registered responsiveness limits, so that saved collaborative editing remains responsive without losing history.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### A native capacity group meets its existing contract
-
-Given the retained first-attempt mobile capacity-flush failure,
-When its cause is investigated and a justified repair is integrated,
-Then the existing unprofiled desktop/mobile limits pass on fresh first attempts,
-And exact content, selection, actual-group history, saved/peer convergence and access boundaries remain intact.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve [the 102.4 ms failure, unknown inner cause, XL scope and prospective diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-142.md#registration-and-scope), agent judgment 2026-11-04 during the owner's continued SPN-120 merge work.
-- Retain 2086 native inputs, fourfold mobile throttle, 32-state grouping, 100-group history retention, 300 ms idle policy and all existing capacity/idle p95/max, input, long-task and drain limits. No forced GC, subtraction of unproved overhead, repeated assertion until green or profile substituted for acceptance.
-- Inspect retained phase/cache/source evidence first. Before further native execution, declare the discriminating hypothesis, exact source/instrumentation, finite count, stop condition and owned cleanup; reassess scope before a new algorithm or architecture.
-- SPN-141's storage repair, SPN-140's constructor repair and SPN-120's finite audit remain separate complete outcomes. Registration and diagnostic success do not satisfy their acceptance.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- Upstream stock-package retirement (SPN-122), native storage or Safari authority repairs, broader framework replacement, product UI redesign and relaxing acceptance.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Reuse current native history/composition semantic/work fixtures; establish a meaningful failing/negative control for the selected cause at the lowest useful layer before repair.
-- Keep isolated editors/peers, native drain witnesses, exact source/harness hashes, observed save/reload/access readiness and owned cleanup. Actual first-attempt desktop/mobile runs own latency; deterministic controls own semantics/work bounds.
-- Preserve scripts/dependencies, native history/sync/idle, evidence, responsiveness fixture/config and shared dependency routing. Keep diagnostics separate from primary samples and prove missing/failed selected evidence cannot pass.
-- Retain original/new failures, native phase/profile clock limits, complete content/history/access results, all required gates and two independent grades above 95 on each exact validation head. Integrate the accepted repair into each blocked PR and obtain fresh acceptance there.

+# 🔬 SPN-142 offline capability and admission review B
+
+Independent nonimplementing review, 2026-11-04, against base `7679351822caaa9535d73d656191f2a6597a3380`. Inspected the dirty documentation checkpoint, temporary probe/experimental helper sources, retained results and watchdog, and existing patch/manager test infrastructure. No source edits or additional workload were performed.
+
+**Disposition: the evidence justifies implementing and testing this narrowly guarded leading-delete-prefix extension. It does not yet justify shipping the patch, claiming native latency acceptance, or attributing the failed 102.4 ms interval to this work.** No grade or validation-push approval is issued for an unimplemented candidate.
+
+## 📌 What the bounded probe establishes
+
+Independently verified the capture hash `714376723b3ef6a048796f7a1903a58181098960960cecb111e22e0594a2e7c8`, current patch-source hash and both experimental helper hashes against `results.json`. There are exactly 320 unique comparisons: eight retained caches plus 32 Enter-position windows, two cache scopes, two directions and ES/CJS helper forms. All 320 record raw deep equality, and the script asserts input nonmutation after both control and experiment. Allocation counts fall in 124 comparisons and increase in none; redo counts are unchanged throughout. Watchdog records command-passed at normal pressure, 1528 ms and sampled peak 431056 KiB. Instrumentation restoration is protected by `finally`.
+
+The position-5 history Undo case reduces counted allocations 1240 → 352 and iterator-next calls 167 → 42. Cases with only zero/one qualified inverse member retain original work. These counters measure calls/allocations through the existing native primitives, not heap bytes, GC pause duration or latency. The source arithmetic maps input states 385–416 to an Enter at offset 5 and a 26-delete inverse prefix. That mapping is not a capture of the failed interval and cannot establish its cause.
+
+The probe prepares the current patch in memory from hash-recognized installed OSS bytes, extracts helper text and evaluates it with the shared required Core runtime. ES and CJS helper generation are both covered; this is not full ES/CJS module installation, state-manager publication, native browser or independent dual-Core-runtime acceptance. The old historical cache capture remains distinct from current-source execution evidence.
+
+## 🧭 Why the narrow algorithm is defensible
+
+The experiment preserves the existing plain-data and exact native-shape guard, changing its result from whole-group Boolean to the length of the initial qualified descending single-character delete run. For a prefix of at least two, it deep-clones the lowest-offset member and changes only its delete length. That is the existing complete-group identity applied to a smaller prefix. It then folds every remaining action through the original JSONX.compose calls in order, never reorders a structural action or searches for later eligible islands. The insert path is unchanged.
+
+The intended proof boundary is therefore precise: the prefix result must equal the original sequential prefix accumulator in complete raw value/metadata shape; composing the identical tail in the same order must preserve the complete result. Deep-cloning the retained prefix action prevents newly mutating the source prefix. Tail ownership still relies on the original composition operation and must be checked in the integrated manager path; the probe's immediate input-nonmutation assertion alone does not prove there are no harmful result/input aliases after publication or later mutation.
+
+This reuses the existing SPN-135 delete identity and SPN-133 leading-prefix convention. It needs no new composition engine, cache policy, group size, timer, publication delay or dependency. The surrounding effort remains XL because proving the semantic boundary and actual integrated latency/access/history outcome is substantial even if the code edit is small.
+
+## 🧪 Required production proof before validation
+
+Use the existing real manager fixture and native semantic/work suites, retaining pristine sequential native and exact pre-SPN-142 patch controls. Do not replace the current algorithm with an implementation-mirroring test oracle.
+
+- Cover prefix lengths 0, 1, 2, odd/even and full group, empty/singleton states, zero/nonzero offsets, and independent history/collaboration caches with different valid prefix lengths and order. Verify complete publications, metadata and application/Undo/Redo snapshots, not only action output.
+- Put each unsupported member at the beginning, middle and end: nonadjacent/constant/ascending offsets, multi-character edits, insertion/mixed actions, Enter/C0/DEL, paragraph/section/custom metadata, unsupported markers, own undefined versus absent fields, styles/valueRangeId and unknown keys. Retain exotic-shape guard negatives (prototype/accessor/nonenumerable/symbol/depth). After the first rejection, the whole tail must remain the original sequential fold; later eligible islands must not be optimized.
+- Prove lowest-offset prefix body and metadata remain exact with deliberately different characters/styles/own fields, including when subsequent structural composition changes that accumulator. Require input nonmutation and appropriate ownership/isolation under later output mutation and shared input references.
+- Exercise actual full-manager publication order, cache draining and no-new-observer/timer behavior. Keep divergent cache and complete history/selection/segment/IME/access controls intact. Raw equality to the previously shipped patch and original native results must not normalize away meaningful metadata.
+- Preserve a meaningful work-reduction control that fails with the exact pre-SPN-142 patch. Unsupported-at-start and short-prefix cases should retain original work; eligible prefixes before unsupported tails may now legitimately reduce work. Existing whole-group fallback tests that demand unchanged counts for every unsupported position need a precise new boundary assertion, not wholesale weakening or deletion.
+- Preserve exact installer recognition/upgrades for pristine and every previously accepted patch, including the current full-group-delete patch; unknown/partial bytes must fail closed in both formats. Do not mutate installed packages during the admission probe.
+
+The 320 captured/window cases are useful regression inputs, not a substitute for these guards, manager semantics or fresh required native first attempts. Before those native runs, record the selected implementation contract and finite acceptance plan; keep diagnostic profiling separate from primary timing and preserve every new first failure.
+
+## 👥 Scope and remaining uncertainty
+
+Owner and Collaborator retain complete history, publication and persisted/peer edits; Link guest must retain identical native semantics and access fences; Operator gains a bounded primitive-work reduction without chance-based retries. Existing storage and Safari authority repairs remain separate.
+
+The retained peak contains a long history phase, but no captured failed cache or plain-sample profile identifies allocation/composition/GC/subscriber/scheduling cause. The proposed extension addresses demonstrable avoidable work on a relevant class of native inverse caches. Phrase that as an independently supported improvement and hypothesis to validate, not a proven repair of the historical spike. Keep the 100 ms maximum, all other limits and original 2086-input workload unchanged. Production admission remains conditional on complete implementation proof, both exact-source reviews and fresh selected acceptance.

-# ⏱️ SPN-142 Resolve the mobile native Doc capacity-flush budget failure
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Owner](../product/personas.md#owner), I want native Doc typing to stay within its registered responsiveness limits, so that saved collaborative editing remains responsive without losing history.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### A native capacity group meets its existing contract
-
-Given the retained first-attempt mobile capacity-flush failure,
-When its cause is investigated and a justified repair is integrated,
-Then the existing unprofiled desktop/mobile limits pass on fresh first attempts,
-And exact content, selection, actual-group history, saved/peer convergence and access boundaries remain intact.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve [the 102.4 ms failure, unknown inner cause, XL scope and prospective diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-142.md#registration-and-scope), agent judgment 2026-11-04 during the owner's continued SPN-120 merge work.
-- Retain 2086 native inputs, fourfold mobile throttle, 32-state grouping, 100-group history retention, 300 ms idle policy and all existing capacity/idle p95/max, input, long-task and drain limits. No forced GC, subtraction of unproved overhead, repeated assertion until green or profile substituted for acceptance.
-- Inspect retained phase/cache/source evidence first. Before further native execution, declare the discriminating hypothesis, exact source/instrumentation, finite count, stop condition and owned cleanup; reassess scope before a new algorithm or architecture.
-- SPN-141's storage repair, SPN-140's constructor repair and SPN-120's finite audit remain separate complete outcomes. Registration and diagnostic success do not satisfy their acceptance.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- Upstream stock-package retirement (SPN-122), native storage or Safari authority repairs, broader framework replacement, product UI redesign and relaxing acceptance.
-
-## Verify
-

-# ⏱️ SPN-142 Resolve the mobile native Doc capacity-flush budget failure
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Owner](../product/personas.md#owner), I want native Doc typing to stay within its registered responsiveness limits, so that saved collaborative editing remains responsive without losing history.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### A native capacity group meets its existing contract
-
-Given the retained first-attempt mobile capacity-flush failure,
-When its cause is investigated and a justified repair is integrated,
-Then the existing unprofiled desktop/mobile limits pass on fresh first attempts,
-And exact content, selection, actual-group history, saved/peer convergence and access boundaries remain intact.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve [the 102.4 ms failure, unknown inner cause, XL scope and prospective diagnostic boundary](../implementation/SPN-142.md#registration-and-scope), agent judgment 2026-11-04 during the owner's continued SPN-120 merge work.
-- Retain 2086 native inputs, fourfold mobile throttle, 32-state grouping, 100-group history retention, 300 ms idle policy and all existing capacity/idle p95/max, input, long-task and drain limits. No forced GC, subtraction of unproved overhead, repeated assertion until green or profile substituted for acceptance.
-- Inspect retained phase/cache/source evidence first. Before further native execution, declare the discriminating hypothesis, exact source/instrumentation, finite count, stop condition and owned cleanup; reassess scope before a new algorithm or architecture.
-- SPN-141's storage repair, SPN-140's constructor repair and SPN-120's finite audit remain separate complete outcomes. Registration and diagnostic success do not satisfy their acceptance.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- Upstream stock-package retirement (SPN-122), native storage or Safari authority repairs, broader framework replacement, product UI redesign and relaxing acceptance.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Reuse current native history/composition semantic/work fixtures; establish a meaningful failing/negative control for the selected cause at the lowest useful layer before repair.
-- Keep isolated editors/peers, native drain witnesses, exact source/harness hashes, observed save/reload/access readiness and owned cleanup. Actual first-attempt desktop/mobile runs own latency; deterministic controls own semantics/work bounds.
-- Preserve scripts/dependencies, native history/sync/idle, evidence, responsiveness fixture/config and shared dependency routing. Keep diagnostics separate from primary samples and prove missing/failed selected evidence cannot pass.
-- Retain original/new failures, native phase/profile clock limits, complete content/history/access results, all required gates and two independent grades above 95 on each exact validation head. Integrate the accepted repair into each blocked PR and obtain fresh acceptance there.

No browser/runtime workload was launched by this review and no source was edited.
+
+## 🔎 Evidence inspected
+
+Worktree base is 7679351822caaa9535d73d656191f2a6597a3380; only the SPN-142 decision checkpoint is dirty. Read the declared checkpoint, full probe.ts, both extracted experiment helpers, current patch generator/strict delete guard and relevant existing manager/semantic/work tests. Independently recomputed the retained capture, patch, installed ES/CJS and generated experiment hashes; all match results.json. All redo primitive counts are unchanged; none of the recorded clone/iterator counters regress. The 32 Enter-position windows are overlapping transformations of retained synthetic captures, not 32 independent observations of the failed native interval. At position 5 the retained history Undo comparison decreases allocations 1240→352 and iterator calls 167→42. The probe operates on extracted helper functions using pinned Core and does not install a patch or execute a native manager/browser. Its instrumentation restoration is in finally. +## 🧩 Why the prefix boundary is coherent
+
+The proposed leading prefix independently satisfies the existing strict complete-group descending-delete rule: plain supported root-body actions, single-character deletes, guarded own fields/metadata and strictly descending adjacent offsets. For that qualified subset the already established native rule retains the lowest-offset action's body and combines delete length. Cloning that last prefix action before modifying its length avoids borrowing the input body for mutation.
+
+If that raw accumulator is exactly the original prefix fold, each subsequent JSONX.compose call receives the same accumulator and same next action in the same order. The proposal does not reassociate the structural tail, resume optimization after an unsupported action, change publication order or modify the insert branch. This is a limited extension of the existing rule rather than a new general composition algorithm. Keep the strict recursive plain-data/descriptor guard; do not admit getters, exotic prototypes, extra fields or arbitrary structural islands on the strength of these captures.

+## 🧪 Required controls before validation publication
+
+The following are admission obligations for the production candidate, not claims that the helper probe has already satisfied them:

Compare complete raw history/collaboration publications against both native original and exact pre-SPN-142 patch, including own undefined fields, selections, mutation metadata and publication order. Apply resulting redo/undo operations to complete snapshots and compare with the independent sequential semantic oracle. Do not replace complete metadata equality with normalized text-only equality.

Include the retained mixed cache and all 32 paragraph positions. Ensure no optimization of later eligible islands after the first unsupported action.
+- Adapt the existing unsupported-delete controls to the new contract: every malformed/unsupported boundary still follows the original sequential tail, although an earlier valid prefix may now reduce work. Cover unknown/own-undefined fields, marker variants, range/paragraph/structural metadata, nonadjacent offsets, length/valueRangeId changes, accessors/non-enumerable fields, symbols and exotic prototypes. Keep full-fallback equivalence when the eligible prefix is shorter than two; use exact raw-output equivalence for longer safe prefixes, rather than deleting former negative coverage because its old whole-group work count changes.
+- Check ownership directly: composition and publication do not mutate retained input caches/actions/bodies; returned or published output must not alias mutable inputs in a way the old fold did not. The probe's immediate input-nonmutation assertion alone does not test post-return aliasing or manager cache/publication lifecycle.
+- Pin the exact current ES/CJS patch bytes as the pre-SPN-142 executable control. A meaningful work-reduction assertion must pass the new mixed-delete path and fail that prior implementation; preserve unchanged work/output for the insert path and already qualified complete-delete groups. Keep original/current/previous upgrade acceptance, partial/unknown-build refusal and fail-before-either-write installation controls. Reuse existing helper derivation rather than create divergent copies of qualification logic. Update the obsolete complete-group comment in the production version.

Numerical exact-commit reviews, feasible local checks and selected hosted acceptance still follow the standing process. Fresh unprofiled desktop/mobile workloads retain all original limits, grouping, history, input, drain, persistence and access criteria; a later pass cannot retrospectively identify the original 94.9-ms history interval's cause.

+## 📌 What the bounded probe establishes
+
+Independently verified the capture hash `714376723b3ef6a048796f7a1903a58181098960960cecb111e22e0594a2e7c8`, current patch-source hash and both experimental helper hashes against `results.json`.
